title: Story pack: guess the number (six look-alikes in three days)
hook: Six look-alike ads, launched within three days. Guess what happened to their spend.
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

A one-question guessing game built on Galvor's analysis. Frame 2 is the quiz. Frame 3 is the answer with its source. Frame 4 says what to do about it before the next launch.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1: Six look-alike ads launched in three days, what happened to their spend? Frame 2 is a quiz with three guesses. Frame 3 shows the answer: 48% less first-month spend each, when six or more look-alikes launched within three days. Frame 4: space them out, or make them different. Frame 5: send this to whoever plans your launches.
cta: Answer the quiz; share with whoever plans launches
